question: which invoices are more than 30 days overdue?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT b.id, b.due_date, b.customer_id, SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity-COALESCE(bi.discount,0))*(1+COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) AS amt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE j.bill_id=b.id AND a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_EXPENSE','PAYABLE','CASH','BANK') AND j.debit>0),0) AS paid FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id=b.id WHERE b.type='Invoice' GROUP BY b.id, b.due_date, b.customer_id) x WHERE x.amt-x.paid > 0.01 AND x.due_date < '2026-05-17'
agent_sql_scrubbed:
SELECT b.invoice_number, b.due_date, c.name AS customer_name, 
  ROUND(SUM((bi.price*bi.quantity - COALESCE(bi.discount,0)) * (1 + COALESCE(bi.tax,0)/100)) - 
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(j.debit) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id = j.account_id 
              WHERE j.bill_id = b.id AND j.debit > 0 
              AND a.account_type IN (?,?,?,?)), 0), 0) AS outstanding
FROM bills b 
JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id = b.id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = b.customer_id
WHERE b.type = ? AND b.due_date < CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY b.id, b.invoice_number, b.due_date, c.name
HAVING outstanding > 0.01
ORDER BY b.due_date ASC
LIMIT 20;
